description: Apply a batch of edits to a .docx as native Word tracked changes (redlines), or accept/reject/reply to existing tracked changes and comments by ID.

author.description: Author name recorded on the tracked changes.

changes.description: The list of changes to apply atomically.

output_path.description: Where to write the edited .docx. Defaults to <name>.redlined.docx beside the input.

name: process_document_batch
